description.zh-Hans: 买东西时由程序回答店里有没有货、有几件、多少钱、订货要几天；KP 只挑商品对应的价目和店的类型。集中了购物、服务付款和定价的指引。
description.en: When the investigator buys, the program answers whether the outlet has the goods, how many, at what price and how long an order takes; the Keeper only picks the printed record and the kind of outlet. Collects the guidance on purchases, paid services and prices.
